title: Kissed Smoke Hot Filipino Ground Beef Pancit Canton
description: A sweet and chewy Filipino dish featuring ground beef and smoke-hot flavors, served in a ramekin and egg-free-friendly, this meal-prep recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pancit canton noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the smoked paprika, hot sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar, and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the ground beef mixture.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a ramekin and top with chopped green onions.
Bake the ramekin in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, until the flavors are kissed with smoke and the noodles are heated through.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F.
